objective: Physically upload the 31 registered official PDF binaries to object storage, round-trip verify, mark verified.

environment_probe.conclusion: No single environment available in-session holds BOTH network paths (bytes + storage) with credentials. Container has the key but no egress to either host; the browser has the bytes but cannot authenticate to the private bucket, and injecting a service-role key into a third-party-origin page is prohibited.

storage_state.access_policy: deny-by-default; service-role only; no permissive storage.objects policy
storage_state.round_trip_verification: implemented + unit-tested (in-memory client); NOT run against live bucket (no network)

turnkey_runner.requires: an environment with network to fs.knesset.gov.il AND to the dev Supabase project + SERVICE_ROLE key
turnkey_runner.behavior: SSRF-guarded fetch -> validate (application/pdf + %PDF- + size) -> SHA-256 vs registered (mismatch=quarantine) -> content-addressed upload (dedup, no overwrite) -> HEAD + full byte round-trip -> stored_objects=verified. No retry on 403/404/429. Idempotent.

gate: NOT_GO (upload_success 0%; the physical step must run in an operator environment)
